title: Black hole firewalls
example_questions: What if you fell into an old black hole?
Is there a wall of fire at the event horizon?
summary: AMPS argued that unitarity, effective field theory and a smooth horizon cannot all hold for an old black hole. One resolution is a firewall: high energy quanta at the horizon that burn up anything falling in, instead of the smooth crossing GR predicts.
support_note: Prompted major research; many physicists now favour resolutions without firewalls.
what_happens: An old black hole (past its Page time) is approached
At the horizon the infaller meets intense radiation instead of empty space
objections: Violates the equivalence principle at the horizon
Islands and ER = EPR offer alternatives

sources.title: Black holes: complementarity or firewalls?
sources.authors: A. Almheiri, D. Marolf, J. Polchinski, J. Sully
